surfaces.condition: A repository is added, removed, reclassified, or its catalog freshness, source commit, or visibility policy changes.
validation: Refresh from Pronto's read-only registered-repository inventory plus authenticated live GitHub provider evidence; verify one row per registered repository and a canonical provider-only LIS row.
Validate schema, duplicate identities, freshness states, provider_visibility, profile_visibility, readme_disposition, current-row requirements, and private URL boundaries.
Keep public catalog data privacy-safe: use opaque local identities and digested private provider identities; never persist local paths or private remote URLs.
Keep missing, needs_review, stale, blocked, and unknown evidence distinct from fully_private; do not infer privacy from absence of provider evidence.
Represent GitHub internal visibility explicitly and treat it as non-public for README eligibility.

surfaces.condition: The profile README or the catalog's README-eligibility policy changes.
validation: Verify the catalog hash, source commit, inventory observation time, and rendered-entry count marker agree.
Verify every current include row with public or explicitly approved private_readme_allowed visibility is rendered exactly once.
Verify exclude, defer, fully_private, missing, stale, and needs_review rows are omitted; private or internal README-allowed rows never emit a private URL or provider identity.
Verify Public Releases remains a flat table and Product Work supplies category highlights plus nested subcategory disclosure, including Product Work > Developer Tooling > Agent-enabled.

surfaces.condition: A confirmed, fresh GitHub visibility readback is ready to project into the generated profile repository.
validation: Create a detached worktree from origin/main and invoke the existing catalog refresh, README generator, and validators there.
Require an exact selected repository row and matching public, private, or internal provider visibility; unknown, stale, failed, and mismatched states stop before publication.
Allow only profile-catalog.json and README.md changes, with non-selected catalog rows and README sections byte-stable apart from generated observation metadata.
Push only to the generated profile repository's main branch after the explicit publication confirmation, then read back hosted README.md and match the generated marker and expected link state.

surfaces.condition: Catalog refresh, README generation, or profile publication workflow changes.
validation: Document the source inventory, read-only refresh boundary, freshness window, and exact command used to render the README.
Keep source/local inventory, provider visibility, README eligibility, and published profile readback as separate evidence lanes.
Document that the publication adapter is a generated-output workflow, not authority to mutate GitHub repository visibility.

surfaces.condition: Any profile catalog or renderer behavior changes.
validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 scripts/check_profile.py
python3 scripts/generate_profile_readme.py --check
Exercise public-link insertion, private/internal suppression, exact diff rejection, and hosted-readback mismatch handling.
